pure-announcement.rationale: It is an idea file describing a technique, with no product, release or funding being announced.

duplicate.rationale: llm-maintained-wiki shares the central pattern but was built from secondary coverage and stays at pattern level; a reader of it still learns the three-layer architecture (immutable sources / wiki / schema), the ingest-query-lint loop, and the index.md/log.md conventions from this primary gist, which that concept itself defers to for specifics.

unfalsifiable.rationale: The claims are an architecture and workflow the reader can reproduce directly; the mechanism is the evidence.

durability.rationale: The compile-at-write-time wiki versus re-derive-at-query-time RAG trade, with its layered architecture and maintenance-cost argument, is tool-agnostic and will read the same in twelve months; the Obsidian/qmd tips are incidental.

actionability.rationale: It hands a reader the exact structure to build — three layers, ingest/query/lint operations, index and log conventions, filing answers back — and this repository is itself evidence the instructions are executable.

atomicity.rationale: It is one pattern statable in a paragraph — an LLM incrementally maintains a persistent wiki between you and raw sources — with architecture and operations as facets of that single idea.
